messages.content: "John has decided to invest his savings. He has $5000 that he wants to invest for a period of 5 years. He is considering two options. The first option is a simple interest scheme that offers an annual interest rate of 4%. The second option is a compound interest scheme that offers an annual interest rate of 3.5% and compounds interest annually. He also came across a third option where he can invest an initial amount of $3000 at an annual interest rate of 5% for 6 years with interest compounded twice a year. Can you help him calculate the returns for each of these options using the calc_Simple_Interest, calc_Compound_Interest, and future_value functions respectively?"

function.description: Compute simple interest. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

principle_amount.description: The principle amount that is invested. This is a float type value.

duration.description: Duration of time period in years. This is a float type value.

annual_rate.description: Interest rate in percentage. This is a float type value.

function.name: future_value
function.description: Calculates the future value of an investment given an interest rate and time period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_investment.description: The initial investment amount. This is a float type value.

interest_rate.description: The annual interest rate (as a decimal). This is a float type value.

time.description: The number of time periods the money is invested for.

num_compoundings.description: The number of times that interest is compounded per time period.
